title: Grand Opening of India Development Centre (IDC) in RheinBrücke
slug: Grand Opening of India Development Centre (IDC) in RheinBrücke
content:
The IDC inauguration marks a key milestone for RheinBrücke attended by Vetri Selvan, Managing Partner and Founder of RheinBrücke IT Consulting, Simon Owers, CFO of American Golf and David F., the Head of IT Innovation & Strategy at American Golf. Their presence underscored the significance of this development and strong ties we share with our partners.

This cutting-edge centre reflects RheinBrücke’s unwavering commitment to delivering unparalleled digital transformation solutions and strengthening our partnership with American Golf, showcasing our relentless pursuit of excellence in providing world-class services.

American Golf is proudly the second client from the Endless LLP portfolio that RheinBrücke has the honour to serve. We take immense pride in supporting American Golf's ambitious digital transformation program, aiming to empower their business operations with innovative & customised solutions. Our sincere gratitude extends to Simon Owers & David F. for their unwavering support and trust in our expertise.

Vetri Selvan, Managing Partner and Founder of RheinBrücke IT Consulting, shared his thoughts: "The IDC is a testament to RheinBrücke's global mission to empower businesses like American Golf with innovative digital solutions. This centre reflects our commitment to long-term partnerships and delivering exceptional value to our clients as we enter this exciting new chapter."

Simon Owers, CFO of American Golf, expressed his gratitude: "The launch of the IDC in Chennai marks a pivotal step forward in our collaboration with RheinBrücke. This new centre will enhance our operational efficiency and growth potential and I would like to extend my thanks to everyone involved for their hard work in making this a reality."

David F., Head of IT Innovation & Strategy at American Golf, added: “We’re excited to strengthen our partnership with RheinBrücke through the new IDC. It enhances our ability to deliver innovative, scalable and sustainable digital solutions while ensuring vital 18x7 support for our business. This centre will be instrumental in supporting our long-term IT and operational strategies."

We also extend our heartfelt thanks to James Waterhouse, Operating Partner to Endless LLP, Suresh KLM and Dr Tim Drye from BrandStak for their active participation in the ceremonial lighting of the lamp, making the event even more memorable & auspicious.

This is truly an exhilarating milestone for us & we are filled with anticipation and excitement as we look forward to a promising future with the American Golf IDC! The journey ahead is full of opportunities & we are committed to making the most of this development.

title: RheinBrücke’s Kinetic ERP MEA Cloud Receives Green Certificate from Moro Hub for Sustainable Cloud Adoption
slug: RheinBrücke’s Kinetic ERP MEA Cloud Receives Green Certificate from Moro Hub for Sustainable Cloud Adoption
content:
We are thrilled to announce that RheinBrücke IT Consulting has been awarded the prestigious Green Certificate by Moro Hub, a subsidiary of Dubai Electricity & Water Authority - DEWA, for our commitment to sustainability. We would like to thank Mohammad Bin Sulaiman, CEO of Moro Hub for awarding us this prestigious certificate at GITEX 2024, highlighting RheinBrücke’s dedication to reducing its carbon footprint and aligning with global sustainability goals.

At RheinBrücke, we are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology to drive innovation while being environmentally responsible. By adopting energy-efficient Green Cloud platform, we are securing scalable, high-performance cloud infrastructure that also supports a greener planet. This recognition highlights the importance of sustainability in technology and the commitment to hosting our Epicor Kinetic ERP MEA Cloud workloads in the government's green data center.

We are honored to receive this recognition and look forward to continuing our sustainable initiatives for a brighter, more sustainable future. We would like to extend our gratitude to Mohammad Bin Sulaiman, Said Abu Saeed Saleem, Dr. Ali Bin Mohammed AlMuwaijei, Arisha P., Vetri Selvan, Sreekanth Ramakrishnan, and Nithish Ramanathan for their invaluable contributions and support in achieving this significant milestone

title: Establishing our Saudi presence and launch of AIMS partnership
slug: Establishing our Saudi presence and launch of AIMS partnership
content:
RheinBrücke established its presence in Saudi Arabia through a new strategic partnership with AIMS. AIMS is a multi-billion-dollar investment holding company headquartered in Jeddah that operates in several sectors, including Investment, Properties, Industrial Trading and Manufacturing, Education, Real Estate, and Hospitality.

We would like to express our sincere appreciation to His Excellency Mohamed Hassan Al Noman, the chairman of the board, Mr. Saleh Abdullah Ibrahim, and the CEO of Business Services, Eng. Tariq Malki, for their tremendous assistance in making this collaboration possible. We also express our gratitude to Mr. Nadeem Zaman, Chief Advisor to the Minister of Investment (KSA), for all the guidance and assistance provided.

Their forethought and vision have started our journey's fascinating, new chapter. Our partnership with AIMS is proof of our constant commitment to providing outstanding experiences and value to our consumers in the Saudi Arabian market.
